content.title: Presentation to Remote Result | Promise, Audience Action, Device Proof
content.summary: A community energy talk leads to one phone activation and a thermal-battery proof. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One speaker makes one bounded functional promise. + One audience action visibly initiates the next state. + The interface action is readable and singular. + A remote device changes state after that action. + The final frame proves the device result without unsupported metrics.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult energy engineer on a small community-stage presentation beside the exact original title NIGHT SHIFT POWER. Return briefly to the engineer pointing toward one simple power-flow diagram without adding claims. Hold the same battery beside a steadily powered desk lamp so remote action and visible result share one final proof.
required_anchors: One speaker makes one bounded functional promise.
One audience action visibly initiates the next state.
A remote device changes state after that action.
The final frame proves the device result without unsupported metrics.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A community energy talk leads to one phone activation and a thermal-battery proof. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
